** clojure-mode
Install =clojure-mode= to provide support for =clojure= development.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
;; First install the package:
;; Emacs integration for clj-kondo via flycheck
(use-package flycheck-clj-kondo
  :ensure t)

;; Now install the checker as soon as `clojure-mode' is loaded
(use-package clojure-mode
  :ensure t
  :after flycheck-clj-kondo
  :config
  (require 'flycheck-clj-kondo))

;; load clojure for literate code
(require 'ob-clojure)
#+end_src

** CIDER
=CIDER= stands for /Clojure(Script) Interactive Development Environment that Rocks!/ and it extends =Emacs= with support for interactive programming in =Clojure=. It uses the =clojure-mode= and =clojure-ts-mode= to edit =Clojure= source files and it adds support for interacting with a running =Clojure= process for compilation, code completion, debugging, definition and documentation lookup, running tests and so on.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
;; CIDER for Clojure Development
;; Clojure(Script) Interactive Development Environment that Rocks!
(use-package cider
  :ensure t
  :defer 5
  :pin melpa-stable
  :preface
  (defun aqua/setup-cider ()
    (interactive)
    (setq org-babel-clojure-backend         'cider
          cider-history-file                "/tmp/nrepl-history"
          cider-hide-special-buffers        t
          cider-repl-history-size           10000
          cider-prefer-local-resources      t
          cider-popup-stacktraces-in-repl   t)
    (eldoc-mode 1))
  :config
  (add-hook #'cider-mode-hook #'aqua/setup-cider)
  (add-hook #'cider-repl-mode-hook #'aqua/setup-cider)
  (add-hook #'cider-mode-hook #'aqua/clojure-things-hook)
  (add-hook #'cider-repl-mode-hook #'aqua/clojure-things-hook))
#+end_src

*** clj-refactor
=clj-refactor= provides powerful refactoring functionality for Clojure projects. It complements the refactoring functionality you'd find in =clojure-mode= and =CIDER=.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp
;; A CIDER extension that provides powerful commands for refactoring Clojure code
(use-package clj-refactor
  :ensure t
  :after clojure-mode
  :config
  (defun my-clojure-mode-hook ()
    (clj-refactor-mode 1)
    (yas-minor-mode 1) ; for adding require/use/import statements
    ;; This choice of keybinding leaves cider-macroexpand-1 unbound
    (cljr-add-keybindings-with-prefix "C-c m j"))
  (add-hook 'clojure-mode-hook #'my-clojure-mode-hook))
#+end_src
